summary: The registrant, Ares Strategic Income Fund, filed an 8-K under Items 3.02 and 8.01 to report an unregistered sale of 1,203,879 Class I common shares at NAV of $26.71 per share for total consideration of $32.2 million, exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation S. The filing also disclosed NAV per share, aggregate NAV of ~$10.2 billion, portfolio fair value of ~$21.8 billion, debt outstanding of ~$12.2 billion, and declared regular monthly distributions for July, August, and September 2026. This is a routine capital raise and periodic disclosure, not a special situation.
